analysis.title: Americas Branded Consumer Goods: Apparel & Accessories: October store traffic update
key_insights: October store traffic (visits per venue, sourced via Placer.ai) was softer across most banners GS tracks, with pockets of improvement.
Department stores were mixed: Y/Y visits-per-venue growth improved at Kohl's and Bloomingdale's, Nordstrom turned negative, and Macy's slowed.
Off-price and thrift growth broadly moderated. Ross Dress for Less and dd's DISCOUNTS remained the strongest performers, and T.J. Maxx improved.
GAP banners: Athleta rebounded to positive growth, Banana Republic was unchanged, and Old Navy and Gap slowed.
URBN banners: Anthropologie improved to flat Y/Y, Urban Outfitters moderated, and Free People eased slightly.
Growth slowed across all tracked global brand banners, and Levi's remained negative. Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger were flat Y/Y.
Athletic traffic weakened: Lululemon, Nike Factory Store and Under Armour Outlet all recorded Y/Y declines in October.

sector_views.rationale: October store traffic softened across most tracked banners, with improvement limited to Kohl's, Bloomingdale's, T.J. Maxx, Athleta and Anthropologie. The note gives no explicit sector stance.

risk_factors: Softer October store traffic across department stores, GAP banners, global brands and athletic retailers.
Nordstrom traffic turned negative Y/Y and Levi's remained negative.

theme_stances.key_argument: October store traffic trends were softer across the banners tracked, though some pockets improved.
theme_stances.evidence: October store traffic trends were softer across the banners we track
